philosophy.quote: Photography is not about the camera. It is about the photographer who sees beyond it.
philosophy.body: We believe the most powerful photographs happen when people forget there's a camera in the room. Our approach is quiet, observational, and deeply human. We come to witness — not to direct.

services.headline: Every love story deserves its own visual language

items.title: Wedding Photography
items.description: From the quiet rituals of preparation to the last dance, we weave together a complete visual narrative of your wedding day. Our documentary approach captures the unscripted moments that define the experience.
items.alt: Bride walking down the aisle in soft cathedral light

items.title: Couple Sessions
items.tagline: A portrait of who you are together
items.description: Whether it's an engagement session, anniversary, or simply a celebration of your relationship, our couple portraits are relaxed, natural, and full of the chemistry that makes your bond unique.
items.alt: Couple sharing a joyful laugh during a golden hour portrait session

items.title: Studio & Editorial
items.description: Our studio space is designed to be a creative canvas. Clean, controlled lighting combined with editorial styling creates portraits that feel magazine-worthy — personal yet polished. Available for individuals, families, and brand campaigns.
features: Dedicated studio space in New York
items.alt: Editorial portrait of a woman in dramatic studio lighting

items.headline: We listen before we look
items.body: Every session begins with a conversation — not a contract. We want to understand your relationship, your story, what makes you laugh, and what moves you. This shapes everything that follows.
items.alt: Couple sitting together in conversation at a warm café

items.headline: We disappear into the moment
items.body: On the day of your session or wedding, you will barely notice us. Our cameras are silent. Our presence is calm. We move quietly through your world, collecting fragments of the real story.
items.alt: Photographer capturing candid moments at a wedding ceremony from a distance

items.headline: We give you images that endure
items.body: Your final gallery is not just a collection of photos. It is an heirloom — a curated sequence of images that tells your story from beginning to end, designed to be treasured across generations.
items.alt: Couple reviewing their wedding photo album together with joy

about.headline: Every frame carries a piece of who I am
bio: I am Sofia Reyes — a fine art photographer with over twelve years of experience documenting love in its many forms. I began my career as a photojournalist, working across three continents, before finding my true calling in the intimate world of wedding and portrait photography.

My work has been featured in Vogue Weddings, Harper's Bazaar Brides, and The Knot. I have photographed over 400 weddings across Europe, North America, and Asia — but each one still feels like the first.
What drives me is not the technical perfection of a frame. It is the silence between moments. The exhale before the vows. The glance across a crowded room. These are the images I live to make.

testimonials.headline: Words from the people we've photographed

items.quote: Sofia and her team have this extraordinary ability to make you forget that a camera even exists. Looking at our wedding photographs now, I see versions of ourselves we didn't even know were there. They captured something I couldn't put into words — but she found it.

We were nervous about our engagement session — neither of us are naturally comfortable in front of a camera. Within twenty minutes we were completely at ease and just... ourselves. The photographs look like something out of a film. We will treasure them forever.

I booked Lumière & Co. after seeing one image on Instagram. When I met Sofia I knew I had made the right decision. She understood our aesthetic without us needing to explain much. The final gallery left me speechless. This is proper art.

We have worked with many photographers over the years for our editorial brand campaigns. Lumière & Co. is in a different category entirely. The quality, the vision, the attention to light — everything is exceptional. They are our studio of choice going forward.

process.headline: From first message to final gallery

items.title: Inquiry & Discovery
items.description: Tell us about yourself and your vision. We'll respond personally within 24 hours to arrange a complimentary consultation call.

items.title: Creative Consultation
items.description: A relaxed conversation to understand your story, preferences, locations, and aesthetic goals. This shapes our entire approach.

items.title: Proposal & Booking
items.description: We prepare a tailored proposal based on your needs. Once confirmed, a 30% retainer secures your date exclusively.

items.title: The Session
items.description: Whether it's an engagement session or your wedding day, we arrive prepared — calm, focused, and completely present for you.

items.title: Curation & Editing
items.description: Every image is hand-curated and edited with our signature approach — honoring natural light, skin tones, and emotional tone.

items.title: Gallery Delivery
items.description: Your private online gallery is delivered within 4–6 weeks, with a curated selection of print-ready, high-resolution files.

inquiry.headline: Your story deserves to be told
